title: Louis sent for him but he feared flying
summary: Armstrong asked him to return, but he refused because of air travel.

blocks.x: Until you went back this time. Yeah, France Jackson.

Did you play at all during the time? No, no. Louis sent for me and I wouldn't quit. Yeah? Yeah, Louis. I had a chance to go back. Yeah, they told me they wanted to see me. How come you didn't go back? I didn't want to ride all them planes. I just started having confidence just about three or four years ago, right? It's my first time. See, I didn't want to ride all the planes. I was in Africa and all the places. Now you don't worry about it? No, I don't worry about it now.
It's safer in the plane than in the car.
